initial_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: a production-ready transparent raw PNG sprite atlas for a 2.5D overhead fantasy action game.
Input image: the supplied image is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Match its bright painterly cream sandstone, clean warm brass machinery, saturated turquoise/indigo glass, richly shaded thick objects, colored hand-drawn contour lines and sunny illustrated storybook feel. Do not reproduce its characters, interface, scene or text.

Primary request: Create ONE complete transparent atlas containing exactly SIX independent game props, laid out in a strict 3-column by 2-row grid. Landscape canvas with equally sized square cells, ideally 1536 x 1024 pixels. All prop pixels and each object's own small contact shadow must be inside the central 76% of its cell, with at least 12% completely transparent gutter on all four cell edges. No objects cross cell edges. Keep every object completely visible with its whole base and shadow.

Row 1, left to right:
1. B03_transformer: a fresh, clean, compact angular transformer in warm bronze and pale cream enamel, thick blocky carved front and top faces, a faceted cyan and purple crystal core, beautiful brass fasteners and sturdy feet. No rust, broken coils or decay.
2. B03_pipe_manifold: a true compact standalone device, a clean brass and ivory pipe junction/manifold with several restrained pipe branches on a low base, vivid teal glass pressure gauges, recognizable angular top and front surfaces. No loose pipe pile.
3. B03_wrecked_drone: a small salvaged but freshly restored clean cream-and-brass angular survey drone body lying firmly on the ground, folded indigo and turquoise glass wings, distinct sturdy silhouette. No junk heap, dirt, debris or wreckage pile.

Row 2, left to right:
4. B04_crystal_cluster: a vivid cyan, lilac and teal faceted crystal cluster sitting on a thick pale stone plinth, clean bright magical material, strong readable volumetric facets.
5. B04_resonance_obelisk: an ornate light sandstone and warm brass obelisk with an inset teal glass resonant core, carved detail and thick substantial stone base. Bright illuminated sides and top, not a dark monolith.
6. B04_broken_receiver: a renewed clean bronze-and-ivory receiver dish on a compact low base, a sky-blue glass lens embedded in the dish, substantial visible rim, angled toward the viewer so both the interior and side/base can be seen. No rust, broken parts or dilapidation.

Style/medium: highly polished hand-painted game environment sprites. Each prop is a genuine three-quarter overhead 2.5D object, with visible broad top planes AND thick front side planes, painted highlights, darker colored outline accents and painterly surface variation. The same camera angle, scale logic and upper-left sunlight for all six. The bottom of each prop rests on a projected ground plane. Small close contact shadows only.
Color palette: bright creamstone and ivory; warm clean bronze/brass; luminous teal, cyan, turquoise, lilac and indigo glass; sunny colorful reference fidelity.
Background: actual full RGBA transparency with transparent gaps around all props.
Constraints: Exactly six props in the stated cell order. No scene, landscape, floor tile, paper, white backdrop, background rectangles, gridlines, labels, words, UI, logos, watermarks, characters, people, pedestal text, aura, pickup glow, radiating glow cloud, particles or large cast shadows. Do not render text or key names. All six must be separate complete props.

refinement.reason: First images had crowded spacing and insufficient magical civilization identity. Final generation uses ornate sun-brass constructs and floating mirror-tide glass while preserving contract keys.

visual_review.B03: Ornamental creamstone/brass construct transformer with suspended faceted crystal, magical pipe device with crystal and tealglass gauges, and an articulated survey drone with jeweled glass wings.
visual_review.B04: Levitating crystal shards over a plinth, reflective mirror-glass obelisk with suspended panels, and floating receiver glass/reflector segments on a visible ground support.
visual_review.limitation: Strict 12% nominal-cell gutters were not achieved by the generator. Metadata records complete alpha>=32 regions with 2px padding, including the obelisk's cross-row top.
